notes: id is null: this mining-site class has no ID and no table anywhere in docs/. A stable-ID decision is required before docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:67 ("Reuse accepted gameplay IDs exactly") can be satisfied; minting one is a boundary decision, not a transcription choice.
Field names are derived from prose because the source has no column headers.
extractionZoneRadiusMeters is null: docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:48 states "Exact radius and any resource-specific size variation remain open."
totalUninterruptedExtractionPerMapSeconds 120 transcribes "two minutes of uninterrupted extraction if all are depleted" (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:72).
Arithmetic check: 8 seams x 200 ore = 1,600 common ore, matching the stated per-map total. Combined with the 20 standard seams (2,000), the map total is 3,600 common ore from ore seams.
"Rich ore" is a high-yield source of ordinary common ore; it is not Hyper Gold and does not persist between runs (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:74).

presentation, map marker, and spawn exclusions (required by docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:140) are not specified for this class in the gameplay docs and are therefore absent rather than guessed.

rarity: less common world finds than standard seams

progressDecay.rule: A completed 40-ore installment is retained, while only the unfinished current 3-second interval can decay.

depletedState: non-interactive mapped landmark for the rest of the run
persistence: run-local; unspent common ore is lost when the run ends
